message.content:
**Gaussian integral**

\[
I=\int_{-2}^{\,2}\!e^{-x^{2}}\;\mathrm{d}x
   \;=\sqrt{\pi}\,\operatorname{erf}(2)
   \;\approx\;
   1.7724538509\times 0.9953222650
   \;\approx\boxed{1.76}
\]

(The exact expression uses the error‑function \( \operatorname{erf}(2)\); numerically it evaluates to roughly \(1.76\).)

---

**Definite integral of \(\sin x\)**  

\[
J=\int_{0}^{\,\pi}\!\sin x\;\mathrm{d}x
    =[-\cos x]_{0}^{\pi}
    =-\cos\pi+\cos 0
    =-(-1)+1
    =\boxed{2}.
\]

Both integrals were evaluated analytically—no external computation was required.
